title: Drift-aware FP8 Gatekeeper and Synthetic Recalibration Runner for Hopper E4M3/E5M2
creator: Aisha Mahoney
description: Implement a drift-aware gatekeeper service that prevents unstable FP8 (E4M3/E5M2) activations by running on-the-fly synthetic recalibration jobs and gating based on cross-batch accuracy and distributional drift signals. This ticket covers the orchestration, lightweight synthetic runner, telemetry schema, and rollout gating logic for enabling FP8 profiles safely on Hopper clusters.
acceptance_criteria: Gatekeeper service deploys and responds to policy queries with < 50ms p95 latency
Automated synthetic recalibration jobs run against the golden validation set and produce a stability score for the candidate profile
Activation gating rejects FP8 profile if stability_score < 0.92 or tokenized-perplexity degradation > 3% vs baseline INT8/FP16
Canary rollout passes 48-hour canary with no customer-facing regressions and telemetry alarms suppressed below configured thresholds
Playbook documents the manual rollback and expedited calibration steps and is validated in a drill
technical_notes: Design: lightweight recalibration runner uses minibatch replay of representative prompts (golden-suite + synthetic perturbations) to estimate per-layer scale drift and outlier frequency. Use E4M3/E5M2 selector that samples both modes in shadow for 5000 requests, compute per-op histogram divergence (KL) and layer-wise quant error. Score combines accuracy delta and histogram drift with tunable weights. Service exposes /evaluate and /activate endpoints. Persist calibration artifacts to s3://redwood-quant-artifacts/<model>/<profile>/
steps: Build gatekeeper microservice (Go) with policy engine and Redis-backed cache
Implement synthetic recalibration runner (Python) that interfaces with runtime via local gRPC test harness
Add golden validation set (2k examples) and synthetic perturbation generator
Instrument telemetry: calibration.score, quant.histogram_kl, activation.decision, per-token-latency.delta
Create end-to-end integration test against a canary hopper cluster (staging-hopper-01)
Run safety drill and document playbook in Confluence
canary_plan: Phase 1: shadow gating for 100k requests over 72 hours on staging-hopper-01. Phase 2: 1% traffic canary for 24 hours with auto-abort if customer_error_rate > 0.1% or stability_score < 0.92. Phase 3: progressive ramp to 25% over a week with daily checkpoints.
rollback_plan: Immediate circuit-break: mark profile as rejected and route requests to INT8/FP16 fallback variant. Run automated rollback job that replays last-24h canary traffic against fallback. Create postmortem ticket with RCA. If false positive gating observed, run expedited recalibration with expanded golden suite and reduce gate sensitivity for a temporary window.
